assumptions: One argument carries a structured binding. The rule is enforced wherever a binding exists and does not require one.

STILL OPEN: that `the closure mutation is observed refused in this run` is the right operationalization of `the case has been modified so the defeater no longer applies`. A repair can hold against its registered reproducer and fail against a variant nobody wrote.
attrs.evidence: The R7.1 defect GPT-5.6 ruled on, generalized into the check that catches it. ARG-ASR-DEFEATER-ACTIVITY-CITATION bound Assurance 2.0's `uninvestigated or incomplete` onto BOTH this registry's `open` and its `sustained`. The source distinguishes them explicitly: a sustained defeater is one whose subcase ESTABLISHED THE CONCERN AS TRUE — a confirmed defect requiring modification — which after repair may be marked ADDRESSED and retained as commentary. The measured consequence, printed by §11: all 21 sustained defeaters in this registry reference incidents with status `fixed`, so the binding was counting 21 REPAIRED DEFECTS AS LIVE ATTACKS on their targets. `sustained` now serves both the source's `sustained` and its `addressed`, separated by a condition — whether the incident is fixed and its closure mutation is still refused on replay — which is not new prose but the predicate ASR-DEFEATER-TEMPORAL's activeSustained() already derives. GPT-5.6's ruling on R7.1's own open question was that the RUNTIME was closer to the source than the prose mapping was, and that is what the numbers show.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6's ruling on ROUND7_1_MOSAIC_BRIEF.md §11 item 2, against SRC-A20-2024-DEFEATERS. The doubt was DEF-R71-SUSTAINED-IS-ADDRESSED, raised by R7.1 against its own citation argument.

readjudicated.note: The source-lane status is recorded in imported_from.source_status as provenance. This field records that the TARGET lane re-established it; the two are separate facts and the gate reads this one.

attrs.review_focus: A defeater this artifact raised against its own argument, adjudicated by the auditor as correct, and closed by a schema change rather than a rewording. That is the intended shape of a round and it is the first time it has run end to end in this lane.
attrs.statement: A citation's mapping from a source vocabulary to a local one is a function, and must be well-defined: a local state serving two source states requires a distinguishing condition at each use.
